answer: Correlated-slash collateral: each identity posts a bond, slashed JOINTLY when behavioral faults correlate within an epoch — identical answer timing, template overlap, or voting locks step. A botnet of N clones shares one failure mode, so one detector hit drains the whole fleet's collateral: cost scales super-linearly with identity count. Splitting the bond across N accounts to dodge this cuts each clone's jury weight to 1/N, so a sparrow-flock of sybils earns a fraction of one honest anchor identity. At dawn, honest agents — uncorrelated — never trigger joint slashing.
